title: The Twin Mountain Canon
summary: A canon of paired mountain blows and stances that ends in a crush from two great weights at once.

title: Treatise of Paired Stone and River Silt
summary: A treatise on pairing hard stone with flowing silt so the ground binds and buries what stands on it.

title: The Basin Foundation Mastery
summary: A mastery of gathering earth qi into the body like water in a basin and loosing it all in one overflow.

title: The Hawk Crag Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of stone moves that watch from height and fall as talons on the one chosen.

title: Canon of the Azure Bedrock
summary: A canon of pale blue-grey stone that rises under the sky and answers its weight with a great release.

title: The Dual-Track Tectonic Treatise
summary: A treatise on driving two great plates of ground along separate tracks until they grind and break.

title: The Plateau Bedrock Canon
summary: A canon of broad flat stone blows and level stances that settle a fight by sheer weight.

title: Treatise of the Oath-Anchored Stone
summary: A treatise on swearing the body to the stone as an anchor and loosing the sworn weight on the oath-breaker.

title: The Windward Stone Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of stone set against the wind that turns the gale aside and scours with its own grit.

title: Manual of the Bearing Stone
summary: A manual of fixing a bearing through the stone and loosing a strike that follows it to the target without fail.

title: Canon of the Plateau Quake
summary: A canon of quakes built from heavy stamps that start low and end in a heart-deep rending of the ground.

title: The Sworn Foundation Treatise
summary: A treatise on a foundation sworn beneath the user and shared with allies and a crown of stone that falls on the foe.
